series.title: Young Workers Unemployment Rate
series.description: Unemployment rates of young workers (age 22-27 without a bachelor's degree)
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
series.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. Young workers are those aged 22 to 27 without a bachelor's degree. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

series.title: All Workers Unemployment Rate
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
series.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. All workers are those aged 16 to 65. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

series.title: Recent Graduates Unemployment Rate
series.description: Unemployment rates of recent college graduates
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
series.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. Recent college graduates are those aged 22 to 27 with a bachelor's degree or higher. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

series.title: College Graduates Unemployment Rate
series.description: Unemployment rates of all college graduates
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
series.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. College graduates are those aged 22 to 65 with a bachelor's degree or higher. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

series.title: Recent Graduates Underemployment Rate
series.description: Underemployment rates of recent college graduates
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
series.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. Recent college graduates are those aged 22 to 27 with a bachelor's degree or higher. Underemployment includes those working part-time for economic reasons or in jobs that do not require a college degree. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

series.title: College Graduates Underemployment Rate
series.description: Underemployment rates of all college graduates
series.source: U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Population Survey (IPUMS)
series.notes: Rates are seasonally adjusted and smoothed with a three-month moving average. College graduates are those aged 22 to 65 with a bachelor's degree or higher. Underemployment includes those working part-time for economic reasons or in jobs that do not require a college degree. All figures exclude those currently enrolled in school. October 2025 results are estimated due to missing data.

series.title: IT & Help Desk Job Postings Index
series.description: Index of online job postings in IT operations and help desk occupations
series.source: Indeed Hiring Lab via Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), Series IHLIDXUSTPITOPHE
series.notes: Indeed calculates the index change in seasonally-adjusted job postings since February 1, 2020, the pre-pandemic baseline. Indeed seasonally adjusts each series based on historical patterns in 2017, 2018, and 2019. Each series, including the national trend, occupational sectors, and sub-national geographies, is seasonally adjusted separately. Indeed switched to this new methodology in December 2022 and now reports all historical data using this new methodology. Historical numbers have been revised and may differ significantly from originally reported values. The new methodology applies a detrended seasonal adjustment factor to the index change in job postings.
